title: 2026 Osheaga Festival Headliners: Twenty One Pilots, Lorde, Tate McRae, Sombr, The xx & Gunna
summary: Geese, Wet Leg, Empire of the Sun, Major Lazer, Clipse, Zara Larsson also on bill for festival taking place from July 31-Aug. 2 at Parc Jean-Dreapeau in Montreal.
contentText:
Montreal’s Osheaga Festival announced its 2026 lineup on Tuesday (Feb. 24), with Twenty One Pilots, The xx, Tate McRae, Sombr, Turnstile, Lorde, Gunna and Major Lazer among the headliners. The event that will take place in Parc Jean-Drapeau from July 31-Aug. 2 will also feature sets from The Neighbourhood, Geese, Kehlani, Wet Leg, JID, Wolf Alice, Empire of the Sun, Mt. Joy, Franz Ferdinand, Little Simz, Clipse, Subtronics, Zara Larsson, Of Monsters and Men, HorsegiirL and many more.

Tickets for the 19th edition of the festival will go on sale on Friday (Feb. 27) at 10 a.m. ET, with an American Express presale kicking off at noon ET on Wednesday (Feb. 25) through 11:59 a.m. ET on Thursday (Feb. 26); click here for ticketing information.

Other acts on this year’s roster include: Amelie Lens, Brutalismus 3000, Max McNown, Yoasobi, KETTAMA, Malcolm Todd, Viagra boys, Mother Mother, Not For Radio, Paris Paloma, Amber Mark, Billie Marten, Bob Moses, Jim Legxacy, VTSS, Bar Italia, Finn Wolfhard, it’s murph, Odd Mob, Wolf Parade, Zulan, CMAT, Oklou, SG Lewis, Spacey Jane, Trixie Mattel, Wunderhorse and more.

Saturday night’s bill is topped by Calgary-born McRae, whose only scheduled show this year will be her Osheaga headlining set. McRae is coming off her highest-grossing tour to date with 2025’s Miss Possessive tour, which grossed $110.8 million and sold one million tickets over 77 shows, according to figures reported to Billboard Boxscore. It will also mark Twenty One Pilots’ first Osheaga set in more than a decade, with Lorde topping the bill after previously headlining in 2017.
